step1_analysis.description: A four-input transconductance amplifier used in an adaptive tuning scheme. It compares the differential peak-to-peak input voltage with the differential peak-to-peak output voltage to generate a control voltage for impedance matching.

paper_reference.title: A 3.3-V CMOS Adaptive Analog Video Line Driver With Low Distortion Performance

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the error amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: 3 bias branches + 2 diff pairs. Assuming 50uA per branch, total current ~250uA. Power = 250uA * 1.8V = 0.45mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The error amplifier consumes a small fraction of the total 26.4mW driver power.

dc_gain.description: Maximum DC voltage gain from differential input to control voltage

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm_diff * (Rout_diff || Rin_mirror) * gm_n3 * Rout_total. Typically 40-60 dB for a two-stage CMOS amplifier.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard two-stage amplifier gain in 130nm process with 0.5um channel lengths.

sky130_expected.calculation: Systematic offset due to asymmetric second stage loading. Should be minimized by design.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ideally zero, but systematic offset exists due to Vds mismatch in the current mirror and second stage.

t_delay.description: Propagation delay for the control voltage to respond to an input peak mismatch

sky130_expected.calculation: Bandwidth must be sufficient for 5MHz video signals. Delay ~ 1 / (2 * pi * BW).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Needs to respond fast enough to track video line variations, but not necessarily at the pixel rate.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power, DC transfer characteristics (gain, offset, swing), and transient response time of the error amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Error Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmp5=5u L_xmp5=0.5u
.param W_xmp6=5u L_xmp6=0.5u
.param W_xmp7=5u L_xmp7=0.5u
.param W_xmp1=5u L_xmp1=0.5u
.param W_xmp2=5u L_xmp2=0.5u
.param W_xmp3=5u L_xmp3=0.5u
.param W_xmp4=5u L_xmp4=0.5u
.param W_xmn1=5u L_xmn1=0.5u
.param W_xmn2=5u L_xmn2=0.5u
.param W_xmn3=5u L_xmn3=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VVBIAS VBIAS 0 0.99

* Reference peak-to-peak input (VIMAX - VIMIN = 0.5V)
VVIMAX VIMAX 0 1.15
VVIMIN VIMIN 0 0.65

* Output peak-to-peak (VOMAX - VOMIN = 0.5V + Vdiff)
V_diff Vdiff 0 dc 0 pulse(-0.1 0.1 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)
B_VOMAX VOMAX 0 V=1.15 + v(Vdiff)/2
B_VOMIN VOMIN 0 V=0.65 - v(Vdiff)/2

XMP5 N1 VBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp5} w={W_xmp5}
XMP6 N2 VBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp6} w={W_xmp6}
XMP7 VCNTRL VBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp7} w={W_xmp7}
XMP1 N3 VOMIN N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp1} w={W_xmp1}
XMP2 N4 VOMAX N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp2} w={W_xmp2}
XMP3 N4 VIMIN N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp3} w={W_xmp3}
XMP4 N3 VIMAX N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp4} w={W_xmp4}
XMN1 N3 N3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn1} w={W_xmn1}
XMN2 N4 N3 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn2} w={W_xmn2}
XMN3 VCNTRL N4 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn3} w={W_xmn3}

* Load capacitor
CL VCNTRL 0 100f

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
  print power

  * 2. DC Sweep for Transfer Curve
  dc V_diff -0.2 0.2 0.001
  let vcntrl_deriv = deriv(v(VCNTRL))
  meas dc max_gain max vcntrl_deriv
  meas dc v_swing_high max v(VCNTRL)
  meas dc v_swing_low min v(VCNTRL)
  meas dc v_offset when v(VCNTRL)=0.9

  * 3. Transient Analysis
  tran 0.1n 100n
  meas tran t_delay_rise trig v(Vdiff) val=0 rise=1 targ v(VCNTRL) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran t_delay_fall trig v(Vdiff) val=0 fall=1 targ v(VCNTRL) val=0.9 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
